01The theme

From noise
to signal.

More connected than ever.
But are we really listening?

The Noise Paradox explores the tension of our times: an abundance of information, and a growing search for meaning. The Quiet Signal is an invitation to pause, look beyond the obvious, and discover the ideas that stay with us.

01

Distraction

An endless stream of information. A thousand things asking for our attention.

02

Overload

More voices. More choices. Somewhere in the rush, meaning becomes harder to find.

03

Reflection

We pause. We question. We listen closely enough to notice a different perspective.

04

Clarity

The noise settles. An idea resonates. A quieter, stronger signal begins to emerge.

“ In a world of endless noise,
the quieter signals often matter the most. ”

About TED

TED is a nonprofit organization devoted to ideas worth spreading. Through talks and conversations, it creates space for people to encounter new ideas and different perspectives.

About TEDx

In the spirit of ideas worth spreading, TEDx is a program of local, self-organized events that bring people together to share a TED-like experience. At a TEDx event, TED Talks video and live speakers combine to spark deep discussion and connection.

These local, self-organized events are branded TEDx, where x = independently organized TED event. The TED Conference provides general guidance for the TEDx program, but individual TEDx events are self-organized, subject to certain rules and regulations.

About TEDxNITKSurathkal

Our journey began at NITK in 2011, bringing innovative and inspiring ideas to the student community. Each edition opens a new conversation, inviting people to rethink what is possible.
